tasks.title: Confirm the example plan shows up
tasks.detail: Run plan-task task_list --plan demo --phase phase_0 and check this task is listed as completed. Verify the dashboard too: plan-task dashboard_serve, then open http://127.0.0.1:4173/task.html.
tasks.progress: Read straight from the example file; nothing had to be edited.

tasks.title: Replace the example tasks with your own
tasks.detail: Edit .ppm/demo/tasks/phase_0.json. Keep ids unique inside the phase, keep the phase field equal to the file name, and use only todo, completed, or fail as status. A task detail must state intent and acceptance criteria, not a script.
